description: Inspect a page for Cloudflare Turnstile free, and clear Turnstile and WAF challenges.
name: io.github.SolveGate/solvegate-mcp

environmentVariables.description: API key for solving. Optional — the inspect_page tool works without one, so the server is useful before you have an account. A free sk_test_ sandbox key needs no card.
environmentVariables.name: SOLVEGATE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.solvegate.io.
environmentVariables.name: SOLVEGATE_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where inspect_page runs. Defaults to https://solvegate.io.
environmentVariables.name: SOLVEGATE_SITE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: SOLVEGATE_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: How long solve_turnstile waits for a pending solve, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.
environmentVariables.name: SOLVEGATE_MAX_WAIT_MS
